description: This file contains shell script functions and procedures for initializing, setting up, and tearing down a MBIM (Mobile Broadband Interface Model) network protocol, including device detection, PIN handling, network registration, and DHCP configuration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the MBIM protocol configuration with default parameters and string options.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Performs the setup of the MBIM interface, including device detection, PIN verification, network registration, and DHCP configuration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Wrapper around _proto_mbim_setup that retries after failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM network interface, disconnecting and updating the network state.
